active_work_item.title: Deterministic trust evaluation harness
active_work_item.depends_on: CP6-01 independently QA-passed and merged via PR #13 at 387b94a17270d3b660534f80deaa846bb818ca3f
active_work_item.reason: Independent QA found a remaining AC2/AC4 trust-grounding defect: potential_risk findings only require a non-empty evidenceRefs array and are not checked to ensure the cited canonical evidence actually supports the asserted risk, so a fabricated risk can borrow unrelated valid evidence and pass. Required regression: unrelated canonical evidence must not legitimize a potential-risk claim, while the legitimate grounded material-concern fixture remains passing. PR #16 is also currently mergeable=false and diverged from current main (8 ahead / 5 behind), so Builder must reconcile the scoped CP7 changes onto current canonical main and rerun exact-head install, lint, typecheck, deterministic tests/evals, and production build before QA handoff. Exact-head CI run 34638683474 was green at d37b1b2cd9e8fb644c1de228d0eb965ea63080b5, making the primary defect a quality-coverage failure rather than a build failure.

commercial_milestone: A stranger can upload 2-3 quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis without fabricated findings

save_game.verified_behavior: CP6 provider-neutral report ownership/payment boundaries, server-derived entitlement, exact-report unlock, recoverable locked states and session-integrity repair independently QA-passed before merge; CP2-CP5 trust behavior remains preserved.
save_game.risks: CP7 changes quality/evaluation infrastructure only. Paid/live model evaluation remains YELLOW and is not authorized; production provider/storage/payment/deployment changes remain RED.
save_game.rollback: Return product behavior to merged CP6 SHA 387b94a17270d3b660534f80deaa846bb818ca3f.
